action.description: Action field of the M&C log line (e.g. IN, REF)

code.description: M&C message code from the log line (e.g. IMP for Data Import, TL for Timeliness)

creationtime.description: Creation time of the imported CADU session, used as the S3P session acquisition start time

domain.description: M&C domain of the log line (e.g. Data Import, Timeliness)

eventtime.description: Event time from the log line, used as the S3P session acquisition stop time

filename.description: Name of the file or session referenced by the log line

filesize.description: Size in bytes of the transferred file

fromurl.description: Source URL the file was polled or transferred from

host.description: Host referenced by the log line

hostname.description: Host name of the S3P station server that emitted the log line

jobid.description: Identifier of the CADU polling job from the log line

log_date.description: Date the log line was emitted, used as the monthly partition field

pid.description: Process identifier of the CADU polling agent from the log line

queueid.description: Identifier of the processing queue entry

reftime.description: Reference time reported in the log line

reportName.description: Identifier of the source report or log file the record was extracted from

status.description: Status reported for the file transfer or polling job

timelinessKey.description: Downlink session timeliness key that identifies the S3P session

tourl.description: Destination URL the file was transferred to
